description: This Java class defines a singleton validator for the 'message subject' header in the Eclipse Ditto project. It checks if a given CharSequence is valid based on no-control-characters rules and throws an exception if validation fails.

classes.name: DittoMessageSubjectValueValidator
classes.description: A singleton final class that validates whether a header value satisfies the no-control-characters constraint for message subjects.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the validator.

methods.name: validateValue
methods.description: Validates the header value, throws exception if invalid.
